slides.texte_overlay:
what people notice about
you in the first 7 seconds

your posture

before you say a word, people read how you stand. shoulders relaxed and back, chin level, tell everyone you're comfortable, and that quiet calm is contagious.

your eyes

people notice whether you meet their eyes or look away. a warm, relaxed look held a second longer than usual feels like real interest and builds trust.

your curiosity

people notice genuine curiosity straight away, and it comes from feeding your mind a little every day. curious people simply seem more alive, and others feel it within seconds.
slides.texte_sophia:
your curiosity

people notice genuine curiosity. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. it shows up in how i talk and listen.

slides.texte_overlay:
your pace

people pick up on whether you rush or move calmly. walking and talking a little slower than everyone else reads as quiet, steady confidence almost instantly.

your hands

people notice what your hands are doing. open, relaxed hands look honest and calm, while hidden or fidgeting hands make people feel a little more guarded and unsure.
